caption: The drawing consists of a single outlined rectangular frame centered on a plain, light-colored background. Within the frame, at its lower right corner, there is a decorative arrangement of various botanical elements. The design features several curved and pointed leaves emerging from a cluster at the bottom center, along with a few small blooming flowers distributed among the leaves. Two prominent spiral or curled line motifs—one at the top right and another at the bottom left—are filled with evenly spaced dots. Most of the lines and botanical details are composed of dotted segments rather than solid lines. The entire composition is monochromatic, using only black or dark gray ink on a pale, almost white paper.
title: Embroidery
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
